landingpage.subtitle: Formula Student team of TU Hamburg
landingpage.teamText:
We, the members of e-gnition, have been developing a new electric and autonomous racing car every year since 2011 to compete in international Formula Student competitions.

Our team currently consists of around 70 students from the Technical University of Hamburg and surrounding colleges and universities. Every year, we start afresh and develop a new racing car concept so that we can actively participate in Formula Student racing events in the coming season.

Over the past 15 years, we have successfully achieved innovations and progress. Yet every year, we take on the challenge anew to reach new heights and set new records!

formulastudent.subtitle: Formula Student
formulastudent.text:
Formula Student is the world’s largest engineering competition.
Every year, up to 600 teams from universities around the world take part in this competition. Formula Student events are held all over the world, attracting many interested students, companies and motorsport fans to almost all major race tracks. What makes this competition special is that the focus is not only on the races (dynamic disciplines), but also on other engineering skills (static disciplines). The aim of Formula Student is to give students the opportunity to apply the knowledge they have learnt at university in a practical setting. It also offers an opportunity to familiarise oneself with important aspects of future working life, such as project management, teamwork and a closer understanding of economic decisions during the design process.

e-gnition, a Hamburg-based team based at the Technical University, has been participating in this competition since 2012.
We offer interested students the opportunity almost every year to experience the entire design and construction of the racing car for themselves. What also makes e-gnition special is the fact that the racing cars have always been electrically powered since the start of the first season. Furthermore, e-gnition has also been competing in this discipline since the first Driverless Competition in Formula Student Germany.
formulastudent.electric_dynamics: We compete in various dynamic disciplines to test the performance and handling of our race car and measure up against other teams.
formulastudent.statics: We are presenting the design of our racing car to a panel of experts to demonstrate that our vehicle is not only fast, but also safe and well-engineered.
formulastudent.driverless: We are developing software to enable our racing car to drive autonomously.

teamlanding.header_alt: The e-gnition Hamburg team celebrating the win at Formula Student Germany 2026
teamlanding.subtitle: One car. One team.
teamlanding.text:
e-gnition Hamburg is the Formula Student team at Hamburg University of Technology – and much more than that:
Since our foundation in 2011, we have been developing an electric racing car every year with over 70 dedicated students. Since 2018, we have also been building an autonomous vehicle. Our goal: to bring innovation to the track – at the international Formula Student competitions.

Interdisciplinarity and cross-university collaboration
We work in an interdisciplinary and cross-university manner: our team members come from a wide variety of disciplines – from engineering and computer science to design, business administration and communication. In addition to TU Hamburg, students from other universities in Hamburg, Bremen and Schleswig-Holstein are also part of our team.

What unites us? A passion for technology, precision and teamwork.
At e-gnition, high-tech and project management meet genuine racing spirit. Together, we tackle challenges in:

  • Electrical engineering – from drive systems and power electronics to safety systems
  • Software development – particularly in the fields of autonomous driving and control engineering
  • Mechanical engineering & design – chassis, suspension, aerodynamics and manufacturing
  • Management & communication – sponsorship, event planning, social media and team organisation

A passion for technology, team spirit and the courage to try something new – with electric and autonomous racing cars, we are actively shaping the mobility of tomorrow as a team.
teamlanding.text2: Here is a brief overview of our departments and a summary of their main responsibilities. All our departments work closely together in an interdisciplinary manner. Do you have any questions? Get in touch!
teamlanding.chassis: Design and manufacture of the monocoque
teamlanding.performance: Design and manufacture of chassis, steering and braking systems
teamlanding.performance3: Design and analysis of transmission, wheel carriers and FDS
teamlanding.aerodynamics: Design and manufacture of the aerodynamics package
teamlanding.aerodynamics2: CFD simulations and other simulations to validate the relevant target values
teamlanding.electronics: Design and manufacture of the battery
teamlanding.electronics2: Planning, assembly and testing of PCBs
teamlanding.embedded3: Development and installation of sensor systems and telemetry
teamlanding.driverless: Integration of sensor systems (lidar and radar)

garagelanding.subtitle: Progress every season
garagelanding.text:
Since 2011, we have been designing and building a new electric racing car every year. Each season, we set ourselves the goal of achieving new milestones with the car. Here is an overview of all the vehicles in the club’s history.

Individual racing cars have achieved significant technical milestones that have greatly advanced our development.
Particularly interesting racing cars from a technical perspective are:
  • the egn12, our very first vehicle
  • the egn15, featuring the first monocoque and aerodynamic package
  • the egn17ev, the first all-wheel-drive vehicle, and the egn17dv, the first autonomous car
  • the egn20/egn21, the first car to combine the autonomous driving system and the driver in the same vehicle
  • the egn24, which uses a new LiDAR sensor setup
You can find out more about each individual car here.

supporterslanding.subtitle: Strong partnerships – a strong team
supporterslanding.text:
As well as an ambitious team, building a new racing car each year also requires strong partnerships and supporters. In particular, the Hamburg University of Technology and its affiliated institutes are very close to us, as they are home to our workshop and our activities. However, our sponsors also play a significant role in bringing our project to fruition.
We also benefit from the organised network of former members within the alumni association.
As a non-profit association, our team relies on donations, which can be made to us by individuals, companies or other institutions.

We are very grateful for the many forms of support we receive and look forward to our close partnerships and collaborations!

Find out more here about our supporters and how you can become one yourself:

aboutus.subtitle: About Us
aboutus.text:
e-gnition Hamburg e.V. is the Formula Student team at Hamburg University of Technology. Since its foundation in 2011, the team has set itself the goal of participating annually in the international Formula Student competitions with an electrically powered and, since 2017, autonomous racing car.

The team consists of around 70 students from the Hamburg University of Technology and surrounding universities and colleges. The team structure is organised in such a way that, for the most part, active students take on the management and planning of the project on their own initiative and implement it.

Every year, both the standards that e-gnition Hamburg sets for itself and those stipulated by the Formula Student regulations become more demanding. With ambition and dedication, a new generation takes on these challenges each year and proudly presents the results of their hard work with the current season’s car.

ourevents.fs-text:

joinus.joinus-text:
We’re always looking to grow and are therefore always delighted to welcome motivated new members to the team!
Are you interested in gaining practical experience in a motorsport club and would like to find out more? Then you’ve come to the right place!
joinus.joinus-button--top: Go directly to the application form
joinus.subtitle: What we offer
joinus.text:
• You’ll quickly get to grips with the project and learn the basics and details of design, planning and manufacturing
  • You can contribute your own ideas and help drive the project forward
  • You’ll learn about modern manufacturing processes and technologies
  • You’ll have the chance to experience Formula Student events as a team member at racetracks across Europe
  • You’ll be part of a helpful, committed and friendly team
  • You’ll get an insight into all areas of our work and develop within the team
  • You’ll build contacts with great companies that support us
joinus.subtitle2: What should you bring to the role?
joinus.text2:
• Motivation to work on a large-scale project
  • Good knowledge of German or English
  • Ability to work on projects in a structured and independent manner
  • Willingness to invest time to meet deadlines
  • Nice to have, but not essential:
    • Interest in the automotive industry or motor racing
    • Enthusiasm for new technologies
    • Experience with specific manufacturing technologies, materials, etc.
joinus.text3:
As a general rule, everyone is welcome here! We’ll teach you what you don’t yet know and carefully train you in your field, even if you have no prior experience.
However, we recommend that you don’t join us straight away as a first-year student, as your focus should still be on starting your studies. But if Formula Student is YOUR calling, please feel free to get in touch with us.

At the moment, we are particularly looking for support in the following departments and areas. However, you are still welcome to apply for all other areas – we look forward to hearing from you!
joinus.text4:
• Operations
    • Photography and videography
    • Finance and sponsorship
    • Event planning/team building
    • Graphic design
  • Electronics
    • PCB design and assembly
    • Battery design and construction
    • Test bench planning and execution
  • Embedded
    • Software programming

alumniverein.subtitle: Who are we?
alumniverein.text: The support association was founded at the end of the second Formula Student season of the main association, “e-gnition Hamburg e.V.”, in the summer of 2013 by a small group of former team members. Since November 2015, as the name ‘Friends and Supporters of e-gnition Hamburg e.V.’ suggests, all alumni, supporters and companies have been able to join the support association.
alumniverein.text2:
As a support association, we aim to create a sustainable and successful future by maintaining and continuously developing the team, in coordination with the board of the active racing team. We are committed to providing both moral and financial support to our team. To this end, we maintain close contact with the active team.
Regular discussions take place regarding old and new concept ideas. We also support the team with event preparations, e.g. through advisory pre-scrutineering or by attending test days, including providing refreshments for all the hard-working testers. Where possible, the Friends’ Association also provides financial support to the team from its available funds and through its members.
A special part of this support is the annual battery sponsorships, which are jointly arranged by our members at the rollout of the new car. Furthermore, the alumni association offers contacts in research and industry, thereby providing access to interesting topics for potential internships or final-year projects for active team members.
alumniverein.text3:
At some point, university life comes to an end, and with it, at the latest, time spent as an active team member. In addition to supporting the main association, we also aim to foster networking among former and current team members, sponsors and fans. In addition to the annual general meeting, members of the Friends and Supporters Association meet for joint events such as:
  • Rollout
  • Barbecue on a test day
  • Poker evenings
  • Go-karting
  • Supporting the team at Formula Student events on site

universitypartners.subtitle: Our university as a foundation
universitypartners.text:
The Hamburg University of Technology (TUHH) provides the premises that are essential to the association’s existence.
We are delighted to receive active support not only from the university itself, but also from the individual institutes, which provide us with significant assistance in manufacturing and are always available to answer any questions.

We are therefore in constant dialogue with the TUHH – and benefit from one another: not only does the TUHH provide us with the foundations and support for our activities, but we also contribute to engineering education at the university. By deepening technical knowledge through practical experience and project responsibility for components within the framework of our project, as well as bringing interdisciplinary work closer to the students, we complement the academic offering at the TUHH with a goal-oriented project.
